### Branch

kunminghu-v3

### Describe the bug

When a fault happens on vector indexed store instructions, e.g. `vsuxei32`, XiangShan does not update `vstart` correctly.

According to the RISC-V Vector spec, when a trap occurs during a vector instruction, `vstart` should contain the element index on which the trap was taken.

### Expected behavior

After a faulting vector indexed store, XiangShan should update `vstart` consistently with the architectural trap semantics.
